cards.title: 01-token-管线
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese educational diagram, clean Notion-style technical illustration. Warm cream background, thin near-black hand-drawn lines, deep blue headings, coral accents, muted gold highlights, generous whitespace. No photorealism, no gradients, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: top-to-bottom flow for the sentence “猫追老鼠”. Four large connected stages with simple arrows:
1. “分词” shows three separate rounded blocks: “猫”, “追”, “老鼠”.
2. “词嵌入” shows each word becoming a short colored coordinate row, not detailed numbers.
3. “位置编码” adds small position badges “第1位”, “第2位”, “第3位” to the three coordinate rows.
4. “向量序列” shows three final vector cards, each combining word identity and position.

At the bottom, one concise Chinese takeaway: “有了词义和位置，token 才能彼此计算关系”. Use only the exact Chinese labels specified. Make arrows and blocks easy to read on a phone. No decorative characters or extra paragraphs.

cards.title: 02-数据库与软加权
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese technical comparison infographic in clean Notion style. Warm cream background, thin black lines, deep blue headings, coral used only for the wrong model, muted gold and teal for the correct model. No photorealism, no gradients, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: equal left and right panels divided by one vertical line.
LEFT title: “传统键值查找”. Show one search card labeled “查询”, an arrow to one key card labeled “键”, then one returned card labeled “一条记录”. Use a coral crossed mark and short caption “命中后返回”.
RIGHT title: “注意力的软加权汇总”. Show one Q card labeled “我在找什么” pointing to three K cards labeled “可匹配特征”; beneath them show three V cards labeled “传递的信息”. Three weighted arrows converge on one result card labeled “加权汇总”. Put the three exact weights “0.7”, “0.2”, “0.1” beside the arrows.
BOTTOM: exact Chinese takeaway “不是只取一条记录，而是按权重汇总信息”. Keep all text large, sparse, and readable.

cards.title: 03-只看与分配
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese educational comparison diagram in clean Notion style. Warm cream background, thin near-black lines, deep blue type, coral for the left warning, teal and muted gold for the right solution. No photorealism, no gradients, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: two stacked panels using the same three token chips “猫”, “追”, “鼠”.
TOP title: “只看一个”. Draw one source chip “追” and one thick arrow only to “猫”; show the other two routes as faded and crossed. Caption: “像二元选择”.
BOTTOM title: “分配权重”. Draw source chip “追” sending three arrows to “猫”, “追”, “鼠”. Label the arrows with the exact values “0.7”, “0.2”, “0.1”. Their widths must follow these numbers. Caption: “权重之和 = 1”.
BOTTOM takeaway: “注意力分配多少，不是只选谁”. Use only the exact Chinese labels specified, with large readable text.

cards.title: 04-点积几何
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese mathematical geometry infographic in clean Notion technical style. Warm cream background, thin black axes, deep blue query vector, muted gold matching vector, coral contrast vector. No photorealism, no gradients, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: one large two-dimensional coordinate plane from a shared origin. Draw three arrows:
- blue arrow labeled “Q”
- gold arrow labeled “K₁” almost parallel to Q, with a small angle arc and label “方向接近”
- coral arrow labeled “K₂” nearly perpendicular to Q, with a right-angle mark and label “近乎正交”

Next to the gold pair, show “匹配分数高”. Next to the coral pair, show “匹配分数低”. A small compact formula card at the bottom reads exactly “Q·K = ‖Q‖‖K‖cos θ”. Under it, one line reads “方向和长度都会影响分数”. Keep the visual geometric, sparse, and legible on a phone.

cards.title: 05-因果热力图
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese educational heatmap infographic in clean Notion technical style. Warm cream background, near-black grid, deep blue headers, gold-to-coral heatmap cells. No photorealism, no gradients outside the heatmap, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: centered 4 by 4 grid. Both row and column labels are exactly “猫”, “追”, “老”, “鼠”. Title: “因果注意力权重”. The upper-right triangle is pale gray with clear Chinese label “未来位置：权重为0”. The allowed lower triangle contains only these exact numbers by rows:
row 猫: “1.000, 0, 0, 0”
row 追: “0.604, 0.396, 0, 0”
row 老: “0.572, 0.201, 0.227, 0”
row 鼠: “0.209, 0.249, 0.166, 0.376”
Use warm colors with darker cells for larger values. Add one small bottom note exactly: “每一行权重之和 = 1”. All labels must be Chinese and all listed numbers must be exact.

cards.title: 06-GQA
cards.prompt:
Square Chinese architecture comparison diagram in clean Notion technical style. Warm cream background, near-black thin lines, deep blue headings, teal Q heads, muted gold K/V blocks, coral only for memory-saving emphasis. No photorealism, no gradients, no English visible text.

LAYOUT: side-by-side panels.
LEFT title: “多头注意力”. Show 8 small teal Q blocks, each connected one-to-one to its own paired gold K/V block. Add a compact badge “Q头：32” and “KV头：32”. Caption: “每个Q头各有一组KV”.
RIGHT title: “分组查询注意力”. Show 8 small teal Q blocks arranged in two groups of four. Each group connects to one shared gold K/V block. Add badges “Q头：32” and “KV头：8”. Place exact annotation “每4个Q头共享1组KV”.
BOTTOM: one memory card with the exact text “KV缓存约降到 1/4”. Add a small subtitle “Qwen3-8B”. Keep the structural sharing unmistakable and text large.
